name: Dead stop
cue: Set the bar over midfoot with a flat, near-horizontal torso.

name: Brace
cue: Keep the floor-supported bar still and brace your trunk.

name: Row up
cue: Drive the elbows back without raising your torso.

name: Lower chest
cue: Bring the bar to your lower chest.

name: Controlled descent
cue: Lower the bar while keeping the hinge fixed.

name: Reset on floor
cue: Let both plates settle before the next rep.
